questions.question: Was the Day-4 sample fixed before replay?
questions.evidence: The 1,000-mint SHA-256 sample from the 36,161-launch denominator was selected before event replay.

questions.question: Were all event hours complete?
questions.evidence: 24/24 hours completed; transport-reset hours 09 and 22 were retried and passed.

questions.question: Does the survival label remain frozen and post-horizon?
questions.evidence: Labels use the unchanged strict (horizon, horizon+5m] window; no Day-4 tuning was applied.

questions.question: Could provider missingness be hidden as inactivity?
questions.evidence: Provider gaps are zero and migration unknown/right censoring remain separate statuses.

questions.question: Is exact-mark observability activity-selected?
questions.evidence: Day-4 mark-resolved tokens had median 339 early trades and 87 buyers versus 9 and 3 unresolved.

questions.question: Did C replicate its Day-3 failure?
questions.evidence: Frozen C minus A PR-AUC was +0.0400 on Day 4 after -0.0633 on Day 3.

questions.question: Is the Day-4 C improvement statistically decisive?
questions.evidence: Cluster bootstrap PR-AUC delta mean +0.0322, 95% interval [-0.0212, +0.1078]; Brier interval also crosses zero.

questions.question: Does the comparison establish profitability or execution quality?
questions.evidence: The target is observable activity, not return, executable liquidity, or PnL.

questions.question: Are participant models ready?
questions.evidence: Point-in-time participant history is immature and raw flow remains SELF-FLOW CONTAMINATED.

questions.question: Does three-day temporal coverage establish stability?
questions.evidence: Only three comparable event days exist; regime dependence and calendar-day effects remain unresolved.

questions.question: Could late-launch censoring bias outcomes?
questions.evidence: Day-4 right censoring is 17/32/51 at 15m/30m/60m and must remain explicit.

questions.question: Does the result justify operationalization?
questions.evidence: No live filter, scanner, alert, watch, trade, or capital behavior was changed; EDGE_VALIDATED remains false.

remaining_risks: activity target may proxy trading persistence
raw participant flow is not exogenous
falsifiers: Day-4 gain disappears under a predeclared larger-day evaluation
C loses to A on subsequent frozen days
economic conditional outcomes fail to differ after observability conditioning
provider or migration audit reveals hidden missingness
next_review_gate: Reassess after 5-7 frozen comparable event-level days with per-day metrics and conditional Stage-2 outcomes.
